{{Quote|The Tinian Codex was forged 2000 years ago on a planet where sight was considered a disability.|Kleya Marki describing the Tinian codex to Lonni Jung|<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />}}
A '''planet'''<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> in the [[Tinia system]] in the [[Zeemacht Cluster]] of the [[Inner Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> was inhabited by a [[species]] known as the [[Tinian]]s.<ref name="What a Festive Evening" />  Around [[2000 BBY]]<ref name="Codex date">During the events of "[[What a Festive Evening]]" which "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" dates to [[3 BBY]], [[Kleya Marki]] states that the Tinian Codex was forged 2000 [[Standard year|years]] ago placing its correction around [[2000 BBY]]</ref> the Tinians forged the [[Tinian Codex]] on the [[planet]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was first mentioned in the [[What a Festive Evening|sixth episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="What a Festive Evening" /> which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]]<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref>
